summary: Sprouts (SFM) fell 25% on a third straight negative-comp quarter, a guidance cut and a CEO transition; it looks closer to a changed story than a one-off, so WATCH. Alphabet (GOOGL, on deck) fell about 12% on AI-capex fears while Cloud grew 103%; an early EVENT near its MOS. Dossier names OPFI and QFIN trip no named sell trigger. URI filed a negative 8-K with new debt but is far above sticker. Not investment advice.

items.why: Event checks 3 and 6 open: three negative-comp quarters and management says it must evolve faster. The outbreak part is temporary. Check the 10-Q for margin, traffic vs ticket and debt. $66 vs MOS $33.
